svg.title: Separate Sale Price, Proceeds, and Commission
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-template-checkout-money-checkpoints; chapter number: 3; title: Separate Sale Price, Proceeds, and Commission; subtitle: Reported checkout examples clarify what a template seller can compare without treating commission as the full cost.; caption: Stack Receipts reports a $20 domestic-card sale leaving $18.50 through Lemon Squeezy or $18.12 through Payhip Free after Stripe. Smart Capital reports a $2.90 Gumroad commission on a $29 template before processing.; assumptions note: Each total starts an independent checkout example. Stack Receipts supplies the proceeds directly; no intermediate fee amounts are estimated. Smart Capital's final deduction is commission only, and no Gumroad net payout is asserted.; note: These Stack Receipts and Smart Capital storefront examples apply to template checkout planning. Job4all separately reports Notion Marketplace charges of 8% plus $0.40; those charges must not be applied to these other platforms.; chart type: waterfall; bars: label: Lemon Squeezy sale; value: 20; display: $20; kind: total; label: Lemon Squeezy proceeds; value: 18.5; display: $18.50; kind: result; label: Payhip Free sale; value: 20; display: $20; kind: total; label: Payhip proceeds after Stripe; value: 18.12; display: $18.12; kind: result; label: Gumroad template sale; value: 29; display: $29; kind: total; label: Gumroad commission only; value: 2.9; display: $2.90 deducted before processing; kind: deduction
